title: Leveraging large language models to mimic domain expert labeling in unstructured text-based electronic healthcare records in non-english languages
summary: The open-access primary article fine-tunes GPT-3 on Turkish respiratory-infection examples to label poorly structured pediatric EHR complaints; four pediatric specialists provide ground truth and the fine-tuned model reaches 99.88% accuracy versus 78.54% pretrained. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
